answer: PRIMARY: Node 10 (FOS <= 0,99, DUSP1 >= 1.36, GRB2 >= -0.38, RPS6kb1 > 0.03)MECHANISTICS RATIOANLZE: Fos encodes c-Fos protein, a member of the AP-1 transcription factor complex . In response to extracellular stimuli, Fos forms heterodimers with Jun proteins, such as c-Jun, to regulate the transcription of downstream genes involved in cell proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, inflammation, stress responses, and immune regulation. Dusp1 is a dual-specificity MAP kinase phosphatase that specifically dephosphorylates p-ERK1/2 and p-JNK, thereby regulating the MAPK/ERK and MAPK JNK pathways, respectively. These pathways play important roles in controlling cell growth, survival, migration, differentiation and apoptosis. Grb2 is a multidomain adaptor protein that binds to activated receptor tyrosine kinases and regulates several signal transduction pathways, including the RAS/MAPK and phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)/AKT pathways. Rps6kb1 is a ribosomal protein S6 kinase beta-1 that belongs to a family of serine/threonine kinases. It plays a key role in the control of translation initiation through its ability to phosphorylate ribosommal protein S6.LITERATURE CONFIRMED MECHANISM: c-FOS , DUSP , Ribosome Protein S6 Kinase beta-family members have been reported to be involved in breast cancer progression. [25–27]. For example, c-fos promotes tumourigenicity and metastasis of basal-like breast carcinoma . In addition, inhibition of Ribosomal Protein S4 kinase beta1 suppresses the invasion and migration of breast cancer cells .New Testable Mechanisms: c-JUN, a member protein of the activator protein-1 (AP-1) complex, which can induce various types of human cancers, has been identified as a potential therapeutic target for breast cancer treatment .
